correctness.rationale: Finite transportation duality and the normalized-molecule convex hull give the exact operator norm. For cross-cluster molecules, a transport decomposition gives the upper bound and an explicit globally one-Lipschitz potential gives equality. Averaging conjugates of an arbitrary projection produces the unique equivariant projection because the cluster-fluctuation representation has no fixed vectors; hence the computed norm is the true minimum over all projections. The argument covers singleton clusters and the endpoints r_i=1. The exact-rational checker passed 263 example certificates and is not used for the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The theorem solves the natural relative projection-constant problem for a canonical fluctuation subspace in a multiparameter finite-metric free-space family, uniformly in dimension. The sharp criterion for one-complementability separates contractivity of orbit averaging from that of its kernel complement, with exact threshold r=m/(2m-2) and sharp constants approaching 2. Nontrivial group-symmetrization proves optimality across all projections, not just a convenient one.
